Read the records above this record, up to its Sources. The get trace view gives the same records.

Usage: provenance [OPTIONS] <TARGET> [ACTION]

Arguments:
  <TARGET>  
  [ACTION]  [possible values: get, trace, create, update, answer, claim, release, submit, discussions, discussion, discuss, reply]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>
          [default: default]
      --format <FORMAT>
          [possible values: json]
      --quiet
          
      --view <VIEW>
          [possible values: record, children, trace, impact, review]
      --depth <DEPTH>
          The number of levels to walk. The default is 1.
      --kind <KIND>
          Record kinds to return.
      --limit <LIMIT>
          The page size. The default is 50.
      --review-link
          Return a link to this record in the running review host.
      --notify <NOTIFY>
          Queue review changes into a Codex thread, or end that registration with off. [possible values: codex, off]
      --thread <THREAD>
          The Codex thread UUID for --notify. The default is CODEX_THREAD_ID.
      --follow
          Stream the current review document and pushed changes as JSON lines.
      --no-open
          Print the review link and do not open it in a browser.
      --type <TYPE>
          
      --stdin
          
      --replace-parent <REPLACE_PARENT>
          Replace this Requirement parent and preserve its other parents
      --with-parent <WITH_PARENT>
          Add this parent before the selected parent is removed
      --commit-pin <commit-pin>

      --name <name>
          
      --origin-message <origin-message>
